title: AARO director's true anomalies

tellings.quote: the Pentagon has said that they have quote true anomalies that they're so stump. And this is Kosla, the new director of the Pentagon's UFO office

plain: The Pentagon is said to have admitted it holds "true anomalies", cases that leave it stumped. Marik von Rennenkampff tells Michels this came from Jon Kosloski, the new director of AARO, the Pentagon's office for UFO reports. Von Rennenkampff raises it to show that even the official UFO office, which tends toward ordinary explanations, says some cases have none.
